scope: predeclared supplementary controls; never select teachers or manual thresholds from dev/final outcomes
manual_policy: evaluate both fixed rules; no best-rule selection from program_dev

neural_direct.teacher: predeclared stage2 equal Transformer ensemble101/202/303, frozen checkpoint hashes; all current edges, conventional reference last
neural_direct.device: cuda, FP32 author-trained value model, one CPU host thread; report GPU inference cost separately
neural_direct.action: choose highest mean predicted value only if >max(0.001pp, across-seed std), stable ascending edge tie; otherwise return conventional GLS priorities exactly
neural_direct.scope: online baseline without LLM; same current state and local-search engine, no future label, no calibrated uncertainty claim

eoh_style.generator: original frozen Qwen NF4, same quantized/casting base as main original-A
eoh_style.initial_population: only the same conventional GLS rule; no free initial LLM programs
eoh_style.parent_selection: rank-proportional 1/(rank+1), seeded without replacement, use up to2 current parents for e1/e2 and one for m1/m2/m3
eoh_style.population_selection: real discovery gap only, earlier source wins ties; allow initial rule, retain top4 unique canonical programs
eoh_style.feedback: real endpoints only; no teacher or dev feedback
eoh_style.program_selection: same main fresh discovery/program_select pools and seeds, up to4 elites, actual program_select gaps; freeze all3 before own dev evaluation
eoh_style.adaptation: EoH-inspired code-only population control with exploration/mutation operators; omits separate natural-language thought evolution and does not claim exact EoH reproduction
eoh_style.cost: all72 outputs consume budget, including failures and duplicates; no cache sharing across studies; source and generation settings match main original-A

dev_pool: main program_dev_eval offsets32..63 per size, after each study's programs frozen; do not feed its outcomes into prompts, teacher or manual choices
formal_timing: after all heavy training/discovery finishes, five solver seeds0..4, 1s and5s deadline checkpoints with all feature/decision/initialization time counted; disclose final atomic-call overshoot and exclude improvements completed after deadline
external_references: pinned LKH mirror and author LEHD greedy/RRC10; recompute all costs under source distance convention; external search/work and hardware differ and are reported as such
final_policy: freeze complete program/method manifest and final evaluation protocol after independent dev, then open final1194; no post-final selection or tuning
